Elongated_Saltatory_Legs.description: Equipped with powerful, elongated hind legs that bulge with bulging muscles and intricate webbing, these amphibian-like appendages grant an unparalleled agility and the ability to leap astonishing distances, allowing the bearer to traverse treacherous terrain with grace and speed.

Pelvic_Hinge_Joints.description: Endowed with a unique set of pelvic hinge joints, this amphibian's lower body is engineered for both aquatic grace and terrestrial agility, allowing for impressive leaps and bounds across varied terrains, though the constant strain on its constitution hints at a physical toll.

Fused_Tibiofibula_Bones.description: The Fused_Tibiofibula_Bones, a rare and formidable adaptation found in the most resilient amphibian warriors, manifests as a thick, interwoven mass of bone that not only fortifies the legs with an innate armor-like quality but also grants a significant boost in constitution, albeit at the cost of slight agility, enabling powerful leaps and steady, enduring strides through the harshest terrains.

Spadefoot_Digging_Heels.description: Embedded with robust spade-like heels, these appendages are perfectly adapted for rapid digging, allowing the spadefoot to swiftly burrow into the earth or traverse rugged terrains with ease, while also subtly enhancing its constitution, fortifying its resilience against the rigors of subterranean exploration.

Hypertrophied_Swimming_Calves.description: Enveloped in a thick, muscular coating, the Hypertrophied Swimming Calves pulsate with amphibian resilience and agility, granting a formidable boost to swimming speed and strength, allowing for swift underwater dashes and powerful leaps from shore to water.

Prehensile_Opposable_Toes.description: Equipped with a set of prehensile and opposable toes, this amphibian's feet are as dexterous as hands, granting exceptional agility and a unique climbing ability that rivals that of arachnids, enhancing their dexterity and allowing them to traverse vertical surfaces with ease.

Fully_Webbed_Hind_Paws.description: Enveloped in a slick layer of membrane that stretches from toe to toe, the fully webbed hind paws of this amphibian entity grant it unparalleled agility and speed both on land and in water, allowing it to dash through currents or glide across the ground with remarkable efficiency.

Parachute_Gliding_Feet.description: Equipped with a network of resilient, elastic webbing between its amphibious toes, these feet allow the bearer to leap from high perches and glide effortlessly through the air, weaving between obstacles with unmatched grace and agility.

Stubby_Ambulatory_Hindlimbs.description: Equipped with stubby, powerful hindlimbs, this amphibian entity can dig through soft ground and move with surprising strength, though its short legs limit its jumping ability. The limbs grant resilience against being knocked over, allowing the creature to remain steadfast in battle or while navigating treacherous terrain.

Extensible_Tarsal_Bones.description: Equipped with an innate ability to elongate their tarsal bones, these amphibian entities can achieve incredible leaps and bounds, their agility and reach enhanced to traverse treacherous terrains with ease, making them masters of acrobatic maneuvers in the wild.
